continuation_reconstruction_asymmetry.description: Formal distinction between forward admissible continuation and inverse reconstructability.
continuation_reconstruction_asymmetry.core_asymmetry_principle: Admissibility of forward continuation (existence and stability) does not imply uniqueness or existence of inverse reconstruction (causal recovery).

asymmetry_targets.asymmetry_basis: Aggregate transport over CSI domains creates stable forward flux but loses specific causal path history (IRR-001).
Projection creates stable admissibility filter but irreducibly clips information exactly at the window boundary (IRR-003).
Multi-branch continuation is a stable primitive dynamic; unique reconstruction of specific branch history is formally excluded (IRR-002).
Projections to metrics are stable but multi-valued in inverse; preimages are recoverable only up to equivalence classes.
